title: Learning Binary Codes with Spiking Neural Networks for Cross-Modal Hashing Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2606.00740v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cross-modal hashing (CMH) uses compact binary codes for efficient image-text retrieval. Most methods learn image-text relationships in a continuous space and binarize the representation only at the end. Semantic learning and bit decisions thus remain largely separate. This work addresses two key questions concerning hash-bit generation: \textbf{(1) How to determine hash bits?} We leverage the discrete nature of spiking activity and determine each bit through competition between positive and negative spikes accumulated over time, rather than through a single firing event or subsequent thresholding of continuous representations. \textbf{(2) How to generate such hash bits?} We propose an unsupervised spiking framework for cross-modal hashing, in which image and text jointly contribute to hash-bit generation through temporal interaction. An activation constraint further prevents unsupported decisions caused by silent channel pairs. Exten

translated_title: 基于脉冲神经网络学习二进制编码的跨模态哈希检索
translated_abstract: 跨模态哈希（CMH）使用紧凑的二进制编码实现高效的图像-文本检索。大多数方法在连续空间中学习图像-文本关系，仅在最后阶段才对表示进行二值化，因此语义学习和比特决策在很大程度上是相互分离的。本工作针对哈希比特生成的两个关键问题展开研究：**（1）如何确定哈希比特？** 我们利用脉冲活动的离散特性，通过随时间积累的正负脉冲之间的竞争来确定每个比特，而不是通过单次放电事件或对连续表示的后续阈值化处理。**（2）如何生成这样的哈希比特？** 我们提出了一种用于跨模态哈希的无监督脉冲框架，其中图像和文本通过时间交互共同参与哈希比特的生成。此外，激活约束进一步防止了由静默通道对导致的缺乏依据的决策。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于脉冲神经网络的无监督跨模态哈希框架，通过正负脉冲随时间积累的竞争来确定哈希比特，并让图像与文本通过时间交互共同生成哈希编码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unsupervised spiking neural network framework for cross-modal hashing, which determines hash bits through the competition between accumulated positive and negative spikes, enabling joint image-text hash-bit generation via temporal interaction.
